title: backend-skeleton java-source-splice request document (--splice-file)
description: D-java-source-splice: the input document for `bskel patch propose --kind java-source-splice --splice-file <path>`. A single Java file plus an ordered, closed-vocabulary list of structural edits -- exactly the four operations handles/providers/java-spring/source-splice.mjs's planJavaSourceSplice() knows how to plan. `locator` identifies a member by its language-guaranteed identity (a type's fully-qualified name plus, for a method, its erased parameter types -- the same rule javac itself uses to forbid two same-named same-erased-signature overloads), never by line/column (those are recomputed fresh on every plan, never trusted from this file).

file.description: Repo-relative path to the single Java source file every edit in this document targets.

type_fqn.description: The single top-level type's fully-qualified name -- V1 refuses a file declaring more than one top-level type.

erased_param_types.description: Method locators only -- the exact erased (generics-stripped) fully-qualified parameter types, in order. This is what disambiguates an overload; a field locator omits it entirely.

replacement.description: The whole new method body, including the enclosing braces: must start with "{" and end with "}".

statements.description: Raw statement text to insert at the top of the method body -- the planner derives the actual replacement (original body text is required to survive as a verbatim suffix).

replacement.description: The new initializer expression only -- no leading "=", no trailing ";".

imports.description: Exactly one fully-qualified import -- at most one add-import edit is permitted per transaction (see the planner's own WHY). No wildcard, no static import.
